content: Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of severe side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. It is essential to maintain a comprehensive list of all products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this list with your healthcare provider and pharmacist. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. For less critical situations, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, while Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. Laboratory and medical tests, such as assessments of kidney and liver function, potassium and magnesium levels, and complete blood counts, should be conducted regularly while using this medication. Ensure that you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. It is crucial to take each dose of this medication as prescribed. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist promptly to establish a new dosing schedule. For storage, refer to the product instructions and consult your pharmacist for specific details. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last updated in May 2024. It is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product.
